verdict.rationale: Pipedream lets users write custom Node.js/Python/Go/Bash code at any step to transform data between steps, use $.export to pass data downstream, and leverage npm packages for transformation/mapping logic, giving ops users full code-level control over data mapping between steps. Missing for 10: no dedicated low-code 'formula'/expression-editor UI evidence (only full code steps), and no independent hands-on report specifically validating step-to-step data mapping workflows.
